items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: I've seen him and I've heard him when he played with Benny Peyton's orchestra in the Palais de Hammersmith.

ctx.x: Yes, Bechet was a curious fine person, but there are some things about Sid. He didn't know music, but he would sit at the piano, and play some of the most beautiful things, you know, from what he heard.
